statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The service is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances in an outpatient setting
The diagnosis codes used are I47.1 and I25.10
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on required precertification or prior authorization not being obtained before services were rendered
